description: Delete one of the signed-in person's collections and all of its items, permanently. Use it only when the person asks to delete that collection. Not for removing one track or hiding a collection; use remove_from_collection, or update_collection with archived true, for those. Returns { deleted, items_deleted, license_records_deleted }. Needs a signed-in account; cannot be undone; confirm must be true. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","confirm":true}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

confirm.description: true, confirming the deletion, which cannot be undone.

name: delete_collection
title: Delete a collection
